text:
sara: Heads-up: target cut for 0.14.2 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need quick confirmations on version pins across API, runtime, console, SDKs. :wave:

priya: I can take console changelog and the console package.json bump. Will open PR in the morning.

matt: Runtime: I've got a tiny API surface change that needs a minor semver bump (0.14.2 -> 0.14.3-runtime). Planning to merge by EOD today. Ping me if you see failing CI. :eyes:

leo: SDKs: opened draft PR for js-sdk, rust-sdk. Links: https://git.redwood/sdks/js/pull/412 and https://git.redwood/sdks/rust/pull/98 . Need review on the compatibility shim in js.

jordan: API service here — no breaking changes, just pinning a new runtime client. I'll add a release-note line in the changelog and tag the PR with release/0.14.x when ready.

release-bot: Deploy window reserved for 2025-08-12T17:00Z -> 2025-08-12T18:00Z (override: eng-releases).

sara: Quick checklist so we don't miss anything:
- api: tag & pin (jordan)
- runtime: merge & cut (matt)
- console: changelog + bump (priya)
- sdks: PR review (leo)
- docs: brief release notes (sara)

leo: small note: JS SDK needs a compatibility test added for kv-cache headers. I added a failing test in the PR so reviewers see it.

matt: FYI command I used locally to verify version file: 
```
cat runtime/package.json | jq '.version'
# or grep -n "version" runtime/pyproject.toml
```

priya: Console PR: https://git.redwood/console/pull/256 - includes changelog draft. Will set reviewers to @sara and @leo.

jordan: API PR: https://git.redwood/api/pull/701 — pinned runtime client to 0.14.3-runtime. Leaving it open for 1 review.

sara: Can folks try to get reviews in by 18:00 PT today so we have a clean merge queue for tomorrow? If any blocker, reply here. :+1:

leo: On it, will tidy the tests and request review now.

matt: merging runtime in ~30m, will add note in the release checklist when done.

release-bot: Note: branch-protection allows force-push after admin merge only during cut windows.

priya: quick QA ask — anyone expect any migrations? Console change is purely UI, no DB changes.

jordan: API has a one-line validation change, no DB migrations.

sara: Great. If we stay on schedule I'll post a final cut reminder 1h before release. Also tagging this thread in the release notes doc for traceability.

matt: runtime merged (sha: a1b2c3d). tagging release/0.14.3-runtime now.

leo: js-sdk PR merged with compatibility shim, rust-sdk still pending one reviewer.

priya: console PR merged and changelog updated.

sara: Final status: api PR pending 1 review (jordan), runtime merged (matt), console merged (priya), js-sdk merged (leo), rust-sdk awaiting reviewer. If api review lands, we are green.

jordan: Review posted, merging now.

sara: Awesome — thanks everyone. I’ll post a 1h reminder and the final release playbook (deploy steps + rollback notes) shortly. :rocket:
